description: Show photos of one trail section (island) of the Stockholm Archipelago Trail: the stage hero image plus photos of places (lodging, food, nature) along it, each with credit and license. Use this when the user wants to SEE what a section looks like. Takes the same identifiers as fetch (sat:section:…, slug or uid). Do not use for maps (use show_section_map).

section.description: Section reference: satId, slug or uid, e.g. 'uto'.

name: show_images

outputSchema.description: Photos of a section: the stage hero plus photos of places along it.
